title: Heat-resistant crops: a hybrid photosynthesis enzyme
summary: At Michigan State University, AlphaFold predicted the 3D structure of glycerate kinase in a crop and a heat-loving alga. Replacing three flexible loops with rigid loops from the alga produced a hybrid that remained stable up to 65 °C. The enzyme has not yet been tested in whole plants.
organization: Google DeepMind and Michigan State University
